caption: The drawing shows a wooden chair with a green seat viewed from the front. The chair has four turned legs and three horizontal rungs connecting each side; the two lower rungs are rounded and decorative, and the upper rung is flatter. The back of the chair consists of widely spaced vertical spindles and a curved, wide backrest with a horizontal slot cut out in the middle. The wood is colored brown with a polished finish, and the seat is a dark green color. In the upper left corner of the drawing, there is a smaller sketch of the same chair with dimensional measurements: 19 inches wide, 44.5 inches tall, and 19 inches deep. The drawing is framed by two thin red lines, one close to the edge and one forming a rectangle around the central image. The lower right corner contains handwritten text: "Vincent P. Rasel 1564 Del. London Gallais."
title: Billiard Chair
